notes: S2/F68 (Z1; §5.5.2: the chain is evaluated in the listed order and the first failing check decides): a grant record cites the depth-9 grant, so its own parent chain has nine links; it is recorded at T4 and the root grant is revoked at T2. A grant record's ancestors are judged at its recorded_at by the same walk, so the record is unverifiable E_GRANT_REVOKED, not E_GRANT_UNRESOLVED.
